verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at support.elicit.com (HTTP 200), which indexes the help center for agents. The cited help articles are served as .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed at clean markdown documentation. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), no llms-full.txt or first-party documentation of the agent-docs offering, the docs root .md path returns 404, and there is no independent corroboration.
